symptom: A first `refresh catalog full source` on FactoryManagement (3,718 documents) took 33 s and 145 s of CPU; a CPU profile put 26% in describeSnippet -> ListSnippets and 13% in describeNanoflow -> ListMicroflows, both decoding custom-widget and flow trees.
cause: describe found its document, and the snippets, pages, layouts and flows it names, by listing every document of the type, and a listing decodes each one. The source build describes every document, so the work grew with the square of the project. The nanoflow path still decoded every nanoflow after the direct fix: describe rebuilds the flow through layoutCheckBackend, a memo that embeds the FullBackend interface and so hid ListNanoflowHeaders from the type assertion.
insight: Measure with mprread.UnitsDecoded() against a fixture you then grow: what a describe decodes must not change when documents it does not print are added. When an optional backend capability is detected by type assertion, every wrapper that embeds the backend interface must forward it, or the fast path silently falls back (mendixlabs/mxcli#1624 was the same trap for microflows); a temporary stack dump in decodeUnits for listings over 5 units finds the caller in one run.
